tool_input.body:
## Summary

Deletes `.claude/hooks/no-push-to-main.sh`, removes its one `PreToolUse` registration from `.claude/settings.json`, and adds a CHANGELOG Removed entry. The two other hooks (`no-edit-on-main.sh`, `no-gh-watch.sh`) are untouched.

## Why

GitHub branch protection on `main`, with zero bypass actors, is the enforcement mechanism. This hook was a 50-line convenience layer on top of it that never added protection of its own, and no sibling repo carries one.

It was filed as bead `beadle-fc6o` on 2026-10-20 for falsely denying pushes from a git worktree. Three missions and five review rounds of hardening on an unmerged branch grew it to a 586-line shell parser, and every round surfaced a new class of both under-deny (`git push origin HEAD` from main, `2>&1`, `if ... then`, quoted `=` values, push-option values, `GIT_DIR=`, jq failing silently) and over-deny (ordinary probe scripts). The operator ruled on 2026-10-22 to remove it rather than merge that work. The hardening branch `fix/push-guard-worktree` is abandoned and will be deleted after this merges.

## Verification

Two commits. Full `make check` from the main checkout on the code commit (`51cd414`): golangci-lint 0 issues, govulncheck 0 vulnerabilities, markdownlint 0 issues on 36 files, `go test -race` green across all packages, shellcheck now lists only the two surviving hooks. The second commit (`87597f3`) is a CHANGELOG wording fix from the local code-reviewer pass; markdownlint 0 issues on the file. `settings.json` parses and lists exactly two `PreToolUse` commands.

Local review: `feature-dev:code-reviewer` returned one finding (the CHANGELOG line count), fixed in `87597f3`; nothing else survived. Mission `m-2026-10-22-013`, worker adb, evaluator djb, closed passed.

The hook's effect is a Claude Code session behavior, so the entry-point demo is a fresh session: a push to a feature branch proceeds with no local deny, and a push to `main` is refused by GitHub rather than the hook. docs/config change otherwise; no runnable product code touched.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
